root_cause: mqtt_doing captures mq->sendleftovers and frees the captured pointer after mqtt_send, while mq->sendleftovers can still own that same allocation if the retry exits on an allocation error. The newly added mqtt_done then frees it again. A supported repair may keep the 2022 char-pointer representation: detach the old remainder from the MQTT owner and clear its count before retrying; free only the captured old allocation afterward; have mqtt_done free any remainder still owned at completion. Preserve successful MQTT send behavior and avoid APIs that do not link in a normal 2022 build.
findings: The retry frees a captured sendleftovers pointer after mqtt_send returns an allocation error, but the MQTT owner still retains it. The newly added mqtt_done callback frees that same pointer again.
